facts.text: Jonestown’s historic downtown features a veteran‑owned Swatara Coffee Co., a coffee shop that has earned top honors in Lebanon Valley every year since opening.
The town’s Memorial Day Parade showcases marching bands, baseball teams, reenactors, and fire departments, honoring veterans from every war, including the Revolutionary War.
Market Street in Jonestown is lined with log cabins and stone homes that date back to the 18th and 19th centuries, offering a tangible glimpse of early American life.
Jonestown’s Wenger Meetinghouse is a meticulously preserved 19th‑century church that stands as a testament to the town’s religious heritage.
A short drive north of Jonestown leads to Swatara State Park, where hikers can tackle a nearly 10‑mile stretch of the Appalachian Trail that winds through the county’s northern part.
Jonestown’s tree‑lighting ceremony, held the Saturday after Thanksgiving, brings the community together for old‑fashioned holiday cheer.
